sql.query: INSERT INTO tb_survey_paper (paper_id, paper_title, qstn_cnt, qstn_add_seq, reg_dt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, getdate())
UPDATE tb_survey_paper SET paper_title = ?, qstn_cnt = ?, qstn_add_seq = ?, upd_dt = getdate() WHERE paper_id = ?
INSERT INTO tb_survey_qstn ( qstn_no, paper_id, qstn_answ, answ_type, answ_cnt, exmp_add_seq, multi_yn, multi_cnt, connect_yn, qstn_ord ) VALUES ( ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? )

mapping.setProperty: qstn_no, paper_id, qstn_answ, answ_type, answ_cnt, exmp_add_seq, multi_yn, multi_cnt, connect_yn, qstn_ord

sql.query: SELECT MAX(qstn_no)+1 AS qstn_no FROM TB_SURVEY_QSTN
INSERT INTO tb_survey_qstn_exmp (exmp_seq_no, exmp_sort_no, qstn_no, exmp_word, connect_qstn_no) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
DELETE FROM tb_survey_qstn_exmp WHERE qstn_no IN (SELECT qstn_no FROM tb_survey_qstn WHERE paper_id = ?)
SELECT a.paper_id, a.paper_title, a.qstn_cnt, CONVERT(VARCHAR, reg_dt, 120) reg_dt, CONVERT(VARCHAR, upd_dt, 120) upd_dt FROM tb_survey_paper a with(nolock)
SELECT a.paper_id, a.paper_title, a.qstn_cnt, a.qstn_add_seq, CONVERT(VARCHAR, a.reg_dt, 120) reg_dt, CONVERT(VARCHAR, a.upd_dt, 120) upd_dt FROM tb_survey_paper a with(nolock) WHERE a.paper_id = ?

mapping.getProperty: paper_id, paper_title, qstn_cnt, qstn_add_seq, reg_dt, upd_dt

sql.query: SELECT a.qstn_no, a.qstn_answ, a.answ_type, a.answ_cnt, a.exmp_add_seq, a.multi_yn, a.multi_cnt, b.exmp_seq_no, b.exmp_sort_no, b.exmp_word, ISNULL(a.connect_yn, 'N') AS connect_yn, (CASE WHEN a.connect_yn = 'Y' THEN b.CONNECT_QSTN_NO else '' end) as connect_qstn_no, a.qstn_ord FROM tb_survey_qstn a LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_survey_qstn_exmp b ON a.qstn_no = b.qstn_no WHERE a.paper_id = ? ORDER BY a.qstn_ord ,b.exmp_sort_no

mapping.getProperty: qstn_no, qstn_answ, answ_type, answ_cnt, exmp_add_seq, multi_yn, multi_cnt, exmp_seq_no, exmp_sort_no, exmp_word, connect_yn, connect_qstn_no, qstn_ord

sql.query: SELECT a.answ, b.qstn_no, c.exmp_word, c.exmp_seq_no, (select status from tb_cyber_user_lecture where user_lecture_seq_no = a.user_lecture_seq_no) as status FROM tb_survey_answ a INNER JOIN tb_survey_qstn b ON a.qstn_no = b.qstn_no LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_survey_qstn_exmp c ON a.answ = c.exmp_seq_no +'' WHERE a.user_lecture_seq_no = ?
INSERT INTO TB_SURVEY_ANSW (answ_seq_no, qstn_no, user_lecture_seq_no, answ, paper_id) VALUES ((SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ANSW_SEQ_NO)+1,1) FROM TB_SURVEY_ANSW as a) , ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO TB_SURVEY_CUST (user_lecture_seq_no, paper_id, proc_yn, reg_dt, upd_dt, proc_dt) VALUES (? , ? , 'Y', getdate(), getdate(), getdate())
UPDATE TB_SURVEY_CUST SET proc_yn = 'Y', proc_dt = getdate() WHERE user_lecture_seq_no = ?
SELECT paper_id as cd, paper_title as cd_nm FROM tb_survey_paper
